messages:
Aisha Rahman: Following the postmortem, we need to finalize customer comms rules: statuspage label taxonomy, RCA access tiers, and how recurring flaps escalate to customer emails. I created a tiny tracker: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-221/tracker :spiral_notepad:

incident-bot: Postmortem uploaded: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-221/postmortem (owner: @Aisha Rahman) :page_with_curl:

Ben Thornton: For statuspage wording I propose three canonical labels only: "Operational", "Degraded performance", "Partial outage". Keep short. Use thresholds: errors >=1% or p95 latency > 2s for >5m => Partial outage; otherwise Degraded.

Hana Ito: Agree on minimal labels. Also we should require a one-paragraph customer summary for any Partial outage to post within 72h. For Degraded incidents a 72h internal summary and a statuspage blurb within 24h is fine.

Liam O'Connor: We keep getting recurring proxy flaps every ~2 weeks. Recommend a rule: if the same subsystem has >=3 incidents in 30d, trigger a weekly digest email to impacted subscribers and auto-open a repeat-pattern ticket (A5) for deeper analysis. I'll own the detection job.

Aisha Rahman: Good — can you add the detection cron and sample query to the tracker? Example cron: "30 02 * * Mon /opt/bin/patterns --incident INC-2026-221 --window 30d --out /tmp/inc221.json"

Ben Thornton: On RCA sharing: two tiers: public redacted summary (72h default, 48h if single-owner fixable) and full technical RCA available on request to customers with a signed NDA or enterprise agreement within 10 business days. Security + Legal + Incident Owner must sign off customer-facing redactions.

Hana Ito: Can Security pre-approve low-risk redactions for speed? I suggest Security can sign alone for internal-only logs, but external-facing docs keep tri-signoff. We'll add an "exception_reason" field in tracker when Security signs alone.

Liam O'Connor: Implementation detail: I'll add tracker columns: "severity_based_deadline", "redaction_signoffs" and "recurring_flag". Also a small webhook sample to request approvals: curl -X POST https://approvals.internal/api -d '{"incident":"INC-2026-221","type":"redaction","approver":"security@redwood.com"}'

Aisha Rahman: Action list recap: A1 statuspage copy & thresholds 00 Ben to finalize and push to tracker; A2 public summary SLA in template 00 Aisha to update template; A3 redaction approval flow & exceptions 00 Hana to draft; A4 recurring-pattern detection job 00 Liam to implement; A5 follow-up deeper analysis ticket open if patterns detected.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: A1 statuspage draft due 2026-07-12T15:00:00Z (owner: Ben Thornton).

Hana Ito: I'll draft the redaction checklist and include example redaction rationale to speed Legal review.

Ben Thornton: I'll post two statuspage variants (short + expanded 72h summary) and tag Legal in the tracker. ETA 2026-07-11.

Aisha Rahman: Thanks all. I'll run a quick 24h check-in and will publish the updated incident template with the new SLA fields. We'll keep the comms predictable and make the recurring patterns visible to product/ops. :white_check_mark:
